bull.b: Sustained high DTC growth and nearly half of sales from the company's own channels strengthen margins, customer data capture and brand control. Over the next several quarters, a DTC-led mix supports margin resilience, repeatability of sales and lower reliance on promotional wholesale dynamics.

Consistently elevated gross margins (~65%) and near-20% adjusted EBITDA reflect durable pricing power from premium positioning and product differentiation. These structural margin levels create room to invest in innovation and marketing while preserving profitability through typical industry cycles in the medium term.

bull.t: Strong Balance Sheet and Cash Generation
bull.b: A net cash position above CHF 1.2bn and positive trailing FCF give On notable financial flexibility to fund R&D, scale DTC and absorb near-term inventory swings. This liquidity reduces refinancing risk and supports strategic choices without forcing value-destructive measures over the next several quarters.

bear.b: A ~30% inventory increase elevates working-capital needs and raises risk of markdowns if wholesale sell-through softens. Excess stock can compress near-term cash conversion and margin sustainability, requiring active sell-in calibration and disciplined pricing to avoid margin erosion in coming quarters.

bear.t: Wholesale Sell-in Reductions and Channel Risk
bear.b: Deliberate wholesale cutbacks protect brand premium but reduce near-term wholesale volumes, creating a revenue cadence shift and greater dependence on DTC to maintain growth. If DTC or product rollouts underperform, wholesale weakness in promotional markets could extend slower top-line recovery.

Elevated U.S. tariffs and uncertain timing for refunds introduce structural timing risk to margins and cash flow. Expected retroactive benefits not yet recognized mean margins and free cash conversion could remain pressured until refunds are realized, complicating short-to-medium term planning.
